_doc: skin.json for the booth-trailer template: a POINTER, not a skin. new-film writes `skin` into film.json "skin"; build_film.py
then runs tools/skin_apply.py (scenes/skin_data.js + design.md tokens) before the lint and the render.
Ember: warm near-black ground, ember accent, high motion profile, keynote captions - the booth look (skins/README.md).
Pick an alternative when the brand is light or the room is bright; run `python tools/brand_kit.py --from-skin <skin>` for the sheet
and approve the look BEFORE the sketch pass. The skin's motion profile and captions.style are the defaults the shots follow.
head_fade: the scene's #black plate reads var(--black) from the skin: dark skins open from near-black, light skins from their own paper
